test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of:: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : OWF :: VDM : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : OWF :: VDM : %

Analysis of Options:

Option 1) # = TBK, % = QYU

For # (TBK) to OWF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd4d97f681e201257bed1d5037e9611b8e8b3b246f263688c8a10a9037a93b22.png] 

For VDM to % (QYU)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0501c8938421c09264113cf38308c48334324988f7b6dc633ccbf31545dc46a4.png] 

**Option 2) # = TBK, % = QYH**

**For # (TBK) to OWF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88142ad5019de1ad7bcd88a18d04861f4e23efd5919cb0c8c4811518bb1ae675.png] 

**For VDM to % (QYH)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe825f5f803e04e6b402fe63f1086eebb95e81215d24a978ed3bea2cb4b910f7.png] 

**Option 2 is correct.**

Option 3) # = TYK, % = QYH

For # (TYK) to OWF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415db09769e25244dab102b10440792dbfd10d55f7f6f8898647be4d7f1d4c67.png] 

For VDM to % (QYU)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f64f985db8691c79c0728be15892fdea8e0659308c99540fe08449cd4ae092b.png] 

Option 4) # = TBM, % = QYH

For # (TBM) to OWF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbc5d2306bf3db94072244c7b0f1c765d539e1c1ff9f32111810e3f757defc57.png] 

For (VDM) to % (QYU)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dd76925ad78263f720239e1d7599a06b1bfb28acd7fef417519fa77e7360b86.png] 

Thus, the analogy holds true only for Option 2 where the pattern (-5, -5, -5) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
